AIRPORT EXPANSION PROJECT COMMENCING AT VANCE W. AMORY
INTERNATIONAL AIRPORT. INITIAL WORKS INCLUDE WESTERN
LAND RECLAMATION AND WESTERN STORM DRAIN EXCAVATION. HEAVY
EQUIPMENT, CONSTRUCTION
VEHICLES AND ASSOCIATED PLANT MOVEMENTS IN THE WORK AREAS
WEST AND EAST OF RWY 10/28. PILOTS ADVISED TO EXERCISE
CAUTION AND CONTACT AMORY TOWER FOR ASSOCIATED OPERATIONAL
INFORMATION.
